description: The track editor's saved edit (base, or null) and its op stack (ops) folded into the one edit Save sends. Ops: {kind: chop, keep: [t, t]}, {kind: cut, remove: [t, t]}, {kind: drop, t}, {kind: move, t, to: [lon, lat]}, {kind: reset}, {kind: split, t}; times in epoch ms. An edit is {keep, remove, drop, move}, move keyed by the time as a string, with no empty field.

cases.name: an unedited track folds to nothing
the fold never carries empty arrays
the saved edit is where the fold starts
steps add to the saved edit
a reset discards the saved edit and every step before it
a second chop narrows the first rather than replacing it
a chop, a cut and two deletes, each from what was visible
a move keeps the point and changes where it is
a point moved twice ends where it was dropped last
a moved point that is then deleted keeps both
a reset clears the saved moves
a split rides beside the edit, not in it
